input.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of California, USA, excluding conflict of laws provisions and excluding the 1980 United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods.
input.rationale: California law with AAA arbitration seated in San Francisco County, and judgment enforceable in the California courts, sits within our accepted fallback (California law and forum) and is nowhere near walk-away territory, which is reserved for an unlisted home jurisdiction or a foreign arbitration seat. We note only that we prefer courts to mandatory arbitration; that is a preferred-position point, not a deviation.
